sql: SELECT CAST((SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL,1,0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL,1,0))) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T1.name), IIF(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL,1,0)) < SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL,1,0)),'YES','NO') FROM longest_absense_from_school T1 LEFT JOIN disabled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name
SELECT CAST(COUNT(T4.name) AS REAL)*100/COUNT(T2.name) FROM enlist T1 JOIN enrolled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name LEFT JOIN male T4 ON T1.name=T4.name WHERE T2.school='ucla' AND T1.organ='air_force'
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.school='uci' AND T4.name IS NULL,1,0)) AS REAL)/COUNT(T1.name) FROM enrolled T1 JOIN disabled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name LEFT JOIN male T4 ON T1.name=T4.name
